Learn How To Take Care Of Your Tattoo

Aftercare

Expect a tattoo to fully heal after 2–4 weeks. Here's how to look after fresh ink and fresh piercings.

Tattoos

  1. Keep the bandage on for 2–6 hours, or as advised by your artist.
  2. First wash with clean hands, lukewarm water, and a mild, fragrance-free soap. Pat dry, don't rub.
  3. Thin layer of healing ointment (like Aquaphor) — don't over-moisturize.
  4. Let it breathe. Avoid tight clothing and never touch it with dirty hands.
  5. Days 1–14: wash twice daily, switch to fragrance-free lotion after day 3–4.
  6. Avoid scratching, soaking, sun exposure, and heavy sweating.
  7. Peeling and light scabbing in week 1–2 is normal — don't pick at it.
  8. After 2 weeks: SPF 30+ on healed ink, stay moisturized and hydrated.

Piercings

  1. Clean twice daily with sterile saline solution — avoid alcohol or peroxide.
  2. Don't touch or twist new jewelry more than necessary.
  3. Keep it dry — pat with a clean paper towel, never a cloth towel.
  4. Mind hair and clothing that can snag or irritate the area.
  5. Stay out of pools, hot tubs, and open water until fully healed.
  6. Sleep with care — avoid pressure on facial or ear piercings.
  7. Watch for infection: increasing pain, swelling, or discharge — contact your piercer.
  8. Be patient. Full healing can take several weeks to months.

Healing time: 2–4 weeks for surface healing, up to 3 months for deeper layers. If you notice signs of infection, contact a doctor immediately.
